column1: # v0.4.14: rows re-frozen for the OIN_RESONANCE_DONOR_FOLD promotion (default-ON).
#   Only fields 1-6 (name, sha_in, sha_out, len_in, len_out, eta) are taken from the fresh run.
#   Fields 7+ are PRESERVED from the previous golden: in a v0.4.9 golden field 7 is the runtime
#   BAND that `gate_v047.sh arm2 --band` filters on, while a fresh row carries xyz_sha there.
#   Splicing whole rows would silently break --band for exactly the rows this release touched.
#   Every changed field-2 (input) hash was verified DETERMINISTIC and lever-attributable by
#   re-encoding in a FRESH PROCESS per lever setting -- in-process perception memos would
#   otherwise let the second encode reuse the first one's answer.
#   ⚠ Field 3 is a FRESH STOCHASTIC GENERATION and is NOT attributable to an encoder lever.
#   Two rows changed round-trip status and NEITHER is caused by this lever; the control on the
#       HEKFEL_comp_0  byte_exact TRUE with the lever off and TRUE with it on
#       FOJJUM_comp_0  byte_exact FALSE both ways (it was already not byte-exact)
#   Do not read either as a v0.4.14 regression.
